mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_schedule SET local_time = #{row.localTime}, time_zone = #{row.timeZone}, incremental_mode = #{row.incrementalMode}, next_fire_at = #{row.nextFireAt}, enabled = #{row.enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id = #{row.taskId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.status AS business_status, r.batch_job_execution_id, b.STATUS AS batch_status, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crawl_checkpoint c WHERE c.run_id = r.id) AS checkpoint_present FROM crawl_run r LEFT JOIN BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION b ON b.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = r.batch_job_execution_id WHERE r.status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSING', 'CANCELLING') ORDER BY r.id
